newsitem.title: CANADA: IPL plans C$650 mln pipeline.
newsitem.headline: IPL plans C$650 mln pipeline.

text.p: IPL Energy Inc said on Friday it planned to build a C$650 million natural gas pipeline link to eastern Canada and the northeastern United States from Chicago.
IPL said the new pipeline would have a capacity of one billion cubic feet a day and link the Chicago hub to markets in eastern Canada and the northeast United States, including New York State.

It said the pipeline would follow existing pipeline rights of way for 354 miles from the terminus of Chicago to Sarnia, Ontario where it would connect with storage and transmission plants of other Ontario gas distributors.
Sarnia is next to the origin of the proposed Millennium Pipeline to the New York market.
IPL said it planned to start an open season in July with regulatory filings in the United States and Canada anticipated in autumn 1997 and completion of construction in late 1999.
